args: Fresh post-high-alignment observation, not a grasp assessment. Check that the same patterned bowl remains upright on the counter and the robot is visibly clear. Request six named depth points: inner and outer are the opposed bowl wall surfaces at the historical world +x rim-pinch sector, about 8 mm below its rim, at matching height; band0 and band1 are the ends of the same continuous approximately 40 mm tangential rim band. Preserve physical sector identity, not screen direction. pad_a and pad_b are the centers of the actual two opposing inner finger contact faces on the CURRENT open hand, not its silhouette or outer faces. Mark unavailable faces invisible instead of guessing. Select a 3-16 vertex polygon wholly within visible textured bowl material away from this pinch sector, excluding robot, rim boundaries and background, for a future motion reference; otherwise patch_identity unknown and polygon empty. Return all declared parameters and named depth measurements. Do not certify unseen descent space, possession, or retention.

context.authorized_motion: High open-hand alignment and downward-tool world yaw only.

result.explanation: The same patterned bowl remains upright at the same counter location in the fixed agentview images. The current hand is visibly separated above it. The historical world +x sector is the front rim in agentview and the left rim in the CURRENT wrist view; its continuous band remains visible without an observed external obstruction. inner samples the visible inner wall in wrist view; outer samples the visible exterior in agentview. Their approximately 8 mm below-rim level, matching height, and the approximately 40 mm band span require depth verification. Neither actual opposing inner contact-face center is identifiable: the current wrist view self-occludes the centers at its lower margin, and agentview does not resolve them. Both pad measurements are unavailable. Their [0,0] pixels are schema placeholders only, not surface selections; no pad depth points are supplied. The reference polygon and region contain only visible textured bowl material away from the pinch sector. This observation does not certify unseen descent space, possession, retention, or task completion.
